findings.description: Changing `if fg is not None:` to `if fg:` drops the foreground color when fg is the valid 256-color index 0, so no escape code is emitted for black.
findings.rationale: Trigger: style('text', fg=0). Mechanism: 0 is falsy, so the `if fg:` guard skips _interpret_color entirely. Impact: the output is unstyled instead of using color 0, a silent wrong result. The same truthiness check on bg (line 684) has the same problem with bg=0.

findings.description: The 0..255 range check for integer colors was removed, so out-of-range values are formatted straight into the escape sequence.
findings.rationale: Trigger: style('text', fg=300) or fg=-1. Mechanism: the int branch returns f"38;5;{color}" with no bounds check, and the tuple branch at line 578 likewise drops the per-channel 0..255 check. Impact: an invalid ANSI sequence is emitted silently, where the previous code raised ValueError.
